messages:
isabel: opened a tiny PR to add a 'Fallback smoke playbook' section to Dedicated provisioning: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4599

matt: paste the YAML here please for quick review.

isabel: pasted:

```yaml
fallback_playbook:
  id: eu-latency-rollover
  trigger:
    metric: p99_latency_ms
    threshold_ms: 170
  guard: compatibility_check  # returns {ok: bool, reason: str}
  actions:
    - route_to: dedicated-eu-fallback
    - reduced_variant: redwood/gpt-small-quant
    - set_rate_limit: 10rps
  smoke_test:
    - curl: 'curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -d "{\"model\":\"redwood/gpt-small-quant\",\"input\":\"toolcall test\",\"tools\":[{}]}"'
    - expect: function_call_ok
  telemetry_labels:
    - routing.fallback: eu-latency-rollover
    - model.variant: gpt-small-quant
```

priya: runtime note: add KV cache warmup check to smoke_test (validate a cached prefix hit) and a line that compatibility_check must ensure tool schema match.

isabel: will add KV check and short prose explaining each step for non-eng readers. docs-bot: link-check flagged /handbook/legal/sla.pdf as private.

matt: link to /handbook/sales/enterprise-sla-summary instead for public docs. lgtm after that.
